dialogue.origin: ロールプレイ宜しくおねがい致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for starting this role-play session.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: きょうはどんな相談でしょうか。年代と性別をお願いします。
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today? Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 15歳　女子
dialogue.content: 15 years old, female.

dialogue.origin: 進路の事です
dialogue.content: It's about my future path.

dialogue.origin: 進路のどんな事でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What specifically about your future path?

dialogue.origin: 将来、声優になりたいです。
dialogue.content: I want to become a voice actor in the future.

dialogue.origin: でもお母さんに反対されてて
dialogue.content: But my mom is against it.

dialogue.origin: 中学卒業したら、声優の学校に行きたいけど、ダメって
dialogue.content: I want to go to a voice acting school after graduating from junior high, but she says no.

dialogue.origin: そうなのね。がっかりしますね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be disappointing.

dialogue.origin: 普通の高校に行きなさいと言われて
dialogue.content: She tells me to go to a regular high school.

dialogue.origin: 来週、進路希望調査票を出さなきゃいけないです
dialogue.content: I have to submit my future plans survey next week.

dialogue.origin: 意見が違って悲しいですね。少し焦りますね。
dialogue.content: It's sad when your opinions differ. It must make you feel a bit rushed, too.

dialogue.origin: でも、普通の高校に行きたくない
dialogue.content: But I don't want to go to a regular high school.

dialogue.origin: そうなの。なぜ、普通高校へいきたくないの？
dialogue.content: I see. Why don't you want to go to a regular high school?

dialogue.origin: 声優の学校に行きたい
dialogue.content: I want to go to a voice acting school.

dialogue.origin: そう、声優になりたいから
dialogue.content: Right, because you want to become a voice actor.

dialogue.origin: 声優になりたいのはどうして？
dialogue.content: What makes you want to become a voice actor?

dialogue.origin: そうです。早く行きたい
dialogue.content: That's right. I want to go as soon as possible.

dialogue.origin: なぜかな分からないけど、やりたい
dialogue.content: I'm not sure why, but I just want to do it.

dialogue.origin: やりたい事があるのはいいね。
dialogue.content: It's wonderful to have something you want to do.

dialogue.origin: でも、小さい頃からずっとなりたいと思ってた
dialogue.content: But I've wanted to be one ever since I was little.

dialogue.origin: お母さんにも言ってた
dialogue.content: I've told my mom about it too.

dialogue.origin: そう、声優のどんなとこがいいのかな？
dialogue.content: I see. What do you find appealing about being a voice actor?

dialogue.origin: お母さんは何を言っていたのかな。
dialogue.content: What has your mother been saying?

dialogue.origin: 声優になれる人は少なくて、失敗するからダメって
dialogue.content: She says very few people can become voice actors, that I'll fail, and so I'm not allowed to do it.

dialogue.origin: そう、やる気なくすね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very discouraging.

dialogue.origin: 来週の調査票に高校の名前書きたくないって言ったら
dialogue.content: When I told her I didn't want to write a high school's name on the survey for next week,

dialogue.origin: ものすごく怒られた
dialogue.content: she got extremely angry.

dialogue.origin: 3日間口きいてない
dialogue.content: We haven't spoken for three days.

dialogue.origin: そう、怒られたら嫌になるね。
dialogue.content: I understand. It's upsetting to be yelled at like that.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: お母さんはあなたの意見をきちんときいてくれたかな。
dialogue.content: Do you feel your mother has properly listened to your opinion?

dialogue.origin: 声優になりたいことは、小さい頃から言ってるから知ってるし、
dialogue.content: She knows I've wanted to be a voice actor since I was little because I've been telling her,

dialogue.origin: 頭ごなしにダメって言うのかな？
dialogue.content: Is she just dismissing it outright and saying no?

dialogue.origin: 成功するわけないって
dialogue.content: She says there's no way I'll succeed.

dialogue.origin: ほんの少しの人が有名になってるって
dialogue.content: She says only a handful of people become famous.

dialogue.origin: そう、成功だけを気にしているのだね
dialogue.content: I see—she seems focused only on whether you'll succeed.

dialogue.origin: お母さんは他に何か言っていますか？
dialogue.content: Has your mother said anything else?

dialogue.origin: 高校は行かないとダメって
dialogue.content: She says I have to go to high school.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、あなたはどう思う？
dialogue.content: I see. And what do you think?

dialogue.origin: 声優の学校に行きたい
dialogue.content: I want to go to a voice acting school.

dialogue.origin: そうなの、早く声優になりたいのね。
dialogue.content: I see—you want to become a voice actor as soon as possible.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: でも、お母さんと食い違って自分の夢をかなえたいね。
dialogue.content: But even with this disagreement with your mother, you want to make your dream come true.

dialogue.origin: お父さんや他の家族の方はなんて言っていますか？
dialogue.content: What do your father or other family members say?

dialogue.origin: やりたいことがあるんだから、高校に行って他の勉強しなくても良くないですか？
dialogue.content: Since I have something I want to do, isn't it okay if I don't go to high school to study other things?

dialogue.origin: お父さんは、何も言わない
dialogue.content: My father doesn't say anything.

dialogue.origin: 一人っ子
dialogue.content: I'm an only child.

dialogue.origin: そっか他の勉強はやることないと感じているのかな。
dialogue.content: I see—so perhaps you feel there's no need to study other subjects.

dialogue.origin: よく分からないけど
dialogue.content: I'm not really sure, though.

dialogue.origin: 義務教育が終われば、一生懸命に勉強しなくても
dialogue.content: Once compulsory education is over, even if I don't study hard,

dialogue.origin: とりあえずは困らないかな
dialogue.content: I don't think I'll have any problems for the time being.

dialogue.origin: 分からないけど
dialogue.content: I'm not sure, though.

dialogue.origin: 高校って行かなくても良いんですよね？
dialogue.content: I don't have to go to high school, right?

dialogue.origin: 絶対行かなきゃいけないなら、義務教育のはず
dialogue.content: If it were absolutely necessary, it would be compulsory education.

dialogue.origin: そうなのね、あなたはあまり必要性感じてはいないようね
dialogue.content: I see—it sounds like you don't feel it's very necessary.

dialogue.origin: 違いますか？
dialogue.content: Am I wrong?

dialogue.origin: 義務教育でないから必ず行く必要はないかな？
dialogue.content: Because it's not compulsory education, you feel you don't necessarily have to go?

dialogue.origin: 行かなきゃいけない？
dialogue.content: Do I have to go?

dialogue.origin: どうかな？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: じゃあ行かない子がいるのはなぜ？
dialogue.content: Then why are there some kids who don't go?

dialogue.origin: 高校へ行くのと行かないのを想像してみてどう思う？？
dialogue.content: How do you feel when you imagine going to high school versus not going?

dialogue.origin: 行かない人もいるけど人それぞれだから
dialogue.content: Some people don't go, but it's different for everyone.

dialogue.origin: じゃあ私がどっちにしても良いんじゃないですか？
dialogue.content: Then isn't it okay for me to choose either way?

dialogue.origin: そうだね。だけど、お母さんの意見も聞いてね。
dialogue.content: That's true. But let's also consider your mother's opinion.

dialogue.origin: なぜ高校へ行くように言われているかな？
dialogue.content: Why do you think she tells you to go to high school?

dialogue.origin: 高校へ行く事が夢じゃないものね。
dialogue.content: Going to high school isn't your dream, after all.

dialogue.origin: どうして声優に夢をもったのか教えてくれるかな？好きなアニメ？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me why you started dreaming of becoming a voice actor? Is it a favorite anime?

dialogue.origin: 分からない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 好きなものは好きなだけ
dialogue.content: I just like what I like.

dialogue.origin: 声優のどんなとこが好きかな？
dialogue.content: What aspects of voice acting do you like?

dialogue.origin: アニメ大好きなんだね
dialogue.content: You really love anime, don't you?

dialogue.origin: あなたは高校へあまり行く気がしないんだね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're not very keen on going to high school.

dialogue.origin: 今までの話を少しまとめてもらっていいかな
dialogue.content: Would it be okay if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたは声優になりたい夢を持っていて、すぐに声優の学校を希望しています。お母さんは反対して高校へ行くのをすすめています。義務教育でないから行かなくてもいいと感じています。
dialogue.content: You have a dream of becoming a voice actor and want to go to a voice acting school right away. Your mother is against it and recommends you go to high school. You feel that since it's not compulsory education, you don't have to go.

dialogue.origin: 感じた事を話してもいいいかな？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I share how I feel about this?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたは夢を持って生きていこうとしています。立派だと思います。
dialogue.content: You are trying to live your life with a dream. I think that's admirable.

dialogue.origin: お母さんの意見も聞いてなぜ声優になりたいのかをしっかり伝えてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Please also listen to your mother's views and clearly explain to her why you want to become a voice actor.

dialogue.origin: 声優になるにしても色々な勉強は必要かと思います。これから独り立ちするにしても勉強して損はないかなとかんじます
dialogue.content: Even to become a voice actor, I think you'll need to study various things. As you become independent in the future, I feel it never hurts to keep studying.

dialogue.origin: まだ、たくさん知る事がありますよね。
dialogue.content: There is still so much to learn, isn't there?

dialogue.origin: 興味を持つことが出てくることもありますその時のためにも勉強はしていてもいいかなと思いますがどうでしょう？
dialogue.content: You might find other things you're interested in, and studying now could be useful for that time. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: お母さんは心配していると思いますから話したくない気持ちを越えてじっくり話あってくださいね。
dialogue.content: I believe your mother is worried about you, so please try to overcome the feeling of not wanting to talk and have a thorough discussion with her.

dialogue.origin: 私は声優の勉強がしたいんです
dialogue.content: I want to study voice acting.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: その気持ちを大切にしてお母さんに伝えてください。
dialogue.content: Please cherish that feeling and convey it to your mother.

dialogue.origin: それでも食い違って悩んだらまた、ここへきてくだいね。
dialogue.content: And if you still feel stuck because of the disagreement, please come back here again.

dialogue.origin: あなたが声優として活躍することを願っています。
dialogue.content: I hope you'll flourish as a voice actor.

dialogue.origin: 時間が過ぎましたのでロールプレイを終了しますが宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Our time is up, so shall we end the role-play session?

dialogue.origin: (はい、ありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Yes, thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 声優になることへの母親の反対
